prompts: A sparse transparent 4x2 grid for a game atlas, exactly eight small full-body sprites of the silver-armored male swordsman in the reference. Camera 3/4 fixed, keep face, brown hair, steel plate and ivory trim, navy cloak, gold-hilt sword in his anatomical right hand, blue silver-rimmed shield on his anatomical left hand. Every body and weapon faces SCREEN LEFT. One independently illustrated left-facing pose per cell, shield on visual right side of chest, no mirroring. Render each character plus weapon SMALL, at most 65 percent of its cell width and height, with broad transparent margins of at least 15 percent on EVERY side of EVERY sprite. For the wide slashes, use a compact foot stance and slightly bent arm so full sword fits inside 65 percent. Nothing touches the canvas edges or adjacent cells. Leave a wider transparent band before the top row and after the bottom row. Four top row poses ready, draw, charge, high windup. Bottom row: leftward strike extending sword point diagonally to the lower left of the knees, leftward follow-through with sword tip at far left of chest, recover blade, ready again. Nose looks left. Physically grounded boots, same baseline in each cell. Sharp painterly realistic contours, portrait human proportions, no effects glow floor labels shadow extra object. NO cropped blade tips at any edge, NO full bleed. Transparent alpha PNG.

Background extraction for a video game texture. Keep this exact eight pose sprite sheet and layout: four columns, two rows, silver male knight with dark blue shield, same left-facing faces, actual sword edges and all boots. Change only the canvas and faint floor shadows. Remove all white and gray backdrop and all floor shadows outside the characters. Output a true transparent PNG so the rgba alpha for every empty area between every body and weapon is 0, including all four corners, and no opaque white or checkerboard. Do not regenerate the eight figures or adjust poses, camera, palette, armor, margins, sword silhouettes or spacing. Preserve complete cutout of each of the eight tiny fully isolated figures.

One fully isolated character pose in each cell, from crown to armored boots and complete sword/shield/cape, standing on the same imaginary floor line with two foot soles near bottom of cell. Even cell grid with no drawn separators, labels, numerals, cast shadows, floor or contact circles, weapon trails, glows, effects, extra figures, or checkerboard fake transparency. Do not touch image edges. Space conservatively so long blades remain completely in their own cells. Feet planted. EXACTLY 4 columns by TWO rows, 8 distinct poses aligned to cell centers, row-major playback. up-screen, viewed from rear three-quarter with a natural head turn showing some profile. Show rear plates and blue cape parted to one side. Blade extends toward upper screen in release and follow through. Read direction as away from viewer, not a jump. Row 1: ready, start wind-up, wind up further, max wind-up. Row 2: explosive directionally clear release, follow-through extending the same path, settle, return. Both rows contain exactly four poses.
